title: Way to make a picture not move with screen shake?

posts.author: cozathemaster
posts.body:
Hi! I've searched a long time and can't find a way to make a picture not shake when I use the screen shake option.
Before using MZ, I was working with RPG maker 2003, and there it was as simple as clicking the "affected by shake" option.
Is there a way to do this in MZ?  It seems something so simple.. , but I can't do it... =(
I found a plugin, but it's for MV. I used it with Fossil and it didn't work...
Thanks in advance!‍

posts.author: suwaimu
posts.body:
so.... do you want to make it shake or do you want to make it scroll?
if you want to make it scroll, you need to use the the map scroll option (or might have another name)

I need to be able to display an image using the "show picture" command, and when using the "screen shake" command, I want certain aspects of the game to not shake. For example, everything on the screen would shake, except for that specific image (think of it like a status image of the protagonist, an element that is "outside" of the game, like a HUD).
Does that make sense?
